code.main_code:
# Smart Door Lock - ESP32 + RFID RC522 + Solenoid Lock + Buzzer + MQTT
import machine, time, network, ujson
from umqtt.simple import MQTTClient

SSID, PWD    = "HOME_NET", "HOME_PASS"
BROKER       = "broker.hivemq.com"
TOPIC_LOG    = b"home/doorlock/log"
TOPIC_CMD    = b"home/doorlock/cmd"
SOLENOID_PIN = 26
BUZZER_PIN   = 27
LOCK_TIMEOUT = 5

solenoid = machine.Pin(SOLENOID_PIN, machine.Pin.OUT, value=1)
buzzer   = machine.Pin(BUZZER_PIN,   machine.Pin.OUT, value=0)

AUTHORIZED_UIDS = {"A3:B2:C1:D0", "11:22:33:44"}

def connect_wifi():
    w = network.WLAN(network.STA_IF)
    w.active(True); w.connect(SSID, PWD)
    while not w.isconnected(): time.sleep(0.3)
    print("IP:", w.ifconfig()[0])

def beep(n=1):
    for _ in range(n):
        buzzer.value(1); time.sleep(0.1)
        buzzer.value(0); time.sleep(0.1)

def unlock():
    solenoid.value(0); beep(2)
    print("UNLOCKED"); time.sleep(LOCK_TIMEOUT)
    solenoid.value(1); print("LOCKED")

def read_rfid():
    import urandom
    pool = list(AUTHORIZED_UIDS) + ["FF:FF:FF:FF"]
    return pool[urandom.getrandbits(2) % len(pool)]

def on_cmd(topic, msg):
    cmd = ujson.loads(msg)
    if cmd.get("action") == "unlock": unlock()

connect_wifi()
client = MQTTClient("doorlock", BROKER)
client.set_callback(on_cmd)
client.connect(); client.subscribe(TOPIC_CMD)
print("Smart Door Lock ready")

while True:
    client.check_msg()
    uid = read_rfid()
    if uid in AUTHORIZED_UIDS:
        print("GRANTED:", uid)
        client.publish(TOPIC_LOG, ujson.dumps({"uid": uid, "status": "granted"}))
        unlock()
    else:
        beep(3)
        client.publish(TOPIC_LOG, ujson.dumps({"uid": uid, "status": "denied"}))
    time.sleep(2)

This MicroPython implementation for Smart Door Lock (Beginner level) covers:

3. Actuator control logic based on threshold values

5. Alert triggers when readings exceed safe limits

debug_guide:
Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, run I2C scanner sketch

Issue: Wi-Fi/LoRa connection instability
Fix:   Add exponential backoff reconnection, check antenna placement

Issue: MQTT / cloud sync failure
Fix:   Verify TLS certificates, broker ACL rules, and topic permissions

Issue: ML model inference incorrect
Fix:   Re-calibrate input normalization, check TFLite model quantization

Issue: Memory leak after extended run
Fix:   Use heap profiler, avoid dynamic allocation in main loop

Issue: Multi-node desync
Fix:   Enable NTP time sync across all nodes, use MQTT retained messages

Recommended Tools:
  • Serial Monitor + remote syslog
  • MQTT Explorer with TLS support
  • Logic Analyzer + oscilloscope
  • Wireshark for network debugging
  • Node-RED + InfluxDB + Grafana stack

debug_guide:
Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, confirm I2C address

Issue: Wi-Fi connection drops intermittently
Fix:   Add reconnection logic in loop(), increase TX power

Issue: MQTT broker not receiving messages
Fix:   Verify broker IP, port 1883/8883, credentials and firewall rules

Issue: Actuator not responding
Fix:   Check relay coil voltage and transistor base current

Issue: Dashboard shows stale data
Fix:   Verify MQTT subscriber is active, check Node-RED debug tab

Recommended Tools:
  • Serial Monitor (115200 baud)
  • MQTT Explorer client
  • Logic Analyzer
  • Multimeter
  • Node-RED Debug nodes

Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, run I2C scanner sketch

Fix:   Add exponential backoff reconnection, check antenna placement

Issue: MQTT / cloud sync failure
Fix:   Verify TLS certificates, broker ACL rules, and topic permissions

Fix:   Re-calibrate input normalization, check TFLite model quantization

  • MQTT Explorer with TLS support

# Smart Thermostat - ESP32 + DHT22 + Relay (heater/cooler) + OLED + MQTT
import machine, time, network, ujson
from umqtt.simple import MQTTClient
import dht, ssd1306

SSID, PWD   = "HOME_NET", "HOME_PASS"
BROKER      = "broker.hivemq.com"
TOPIC_STATE = b"home/thermostat/state"
TOPIC_SET   = b"home/thermostat/set"

dht_sensor = dht.DHT22(machine.Pin(4))
heater     = machine.Pin(25, machine.Pin.OUT, value=0)
cooler     = machine.Pin(26, machine.Pin.OUT, value=0)
i2c        = machine.I2C(0, sda=machine.Pin(21), scl=machine.Pin(22))
display    = ssd1306.SSD1306_I2C(128, 64, i2c)

setpoint   = 24.0
hysteresis = 0.5

def update_display(t, h, mode):
    display.fill(0)
    display.text("Thermostat",     0, 0)
    display.text(f"Temp: {t:.1f}C",  0, 16)
    display.text(f"Hum:  {h:.0f}%",  0, 28)
    display.text(f"Set:  {setpoint:.1f}C", 0, 40)
    display.text(f"Mode: {mode}",    0, 52)
    display.show()

def control(t):
    if t < setpoint - hysteresis:
        heater.value(1); cooler.value(0); return "HEAT"
    elif t > setpoint + hysteresis:
        heater.value(0); cooler.value(1); return "COOL"
    else:
        heater.value(0); cooler.value(0); return "IDLE"

def on_msg(topic, msg):
    global setpoint
    data = ujson.loads(msg)
    if "setpoint" in data: setpoint = float(data["setpoint"])

def connect():
    w = network.WLAN(network.STA_IF)
    w.active(True); w.connect(SSID, PWD)
    while not w.isconnected(): time.sleep(0.3)

connect()
mqtt = MQTTClient("thermostat", BROKER)
mqtt.set_callback(on_msg); mqtt.connect(); mqtt.subscribe(TOPIC_SET)

while True:
    mqtt.check_msg()
    dht_sensor.measure()
    t, h = dht_sensor.temperature(), dht_sensor.humidity()
    mode = control(t)
    update_display(t, h, mode)
    mqtt.publish(TOPIC_STATE, ujson.dumps(
        {"temp": t, "humidity": h, "setpoint": setpoint, "mode": mode}))
    time.sleep(5)

# Automated Pet Feeder - ESP32 + Servo Motor + HC-SR04 + NTP Schedule + MQTT
import machine, time, network, ujson
from umqtt.simple import MQTTClient
import ntptime

SSID, PWD = "HOME_NET", "HOME_PASS"
BROKER    = "broker.hivemq.com"
TOPIC_LOG = b"home/petfeeder/log"
TOPIC_CMD = b"home/petfeeder/cmd"

SERVO_PIN = 18
TRIG_PIN  = 5
ECHO_PIN  = 4

servo = machine.PWM(machine.Pin(SERVO_PIN), freq=50)
FEED_SCHEDULE = [
    {"hour": 8,  "minute": 0,  "grams": 50},
    {"hour": 13, "minute": 0,  "grams": 50},
    {"hour": 18, "minute": 30, "grams": 80},
]

def set_servo(angle):
    duty = int(40 + (angle / 180) * 75)
    servo.duty(duty)

def dispense(grams):
    print(f"Dispensing ~{grams}g")
    set_servo(90); time.sleep(grams / 50)
    set_servo(0);  time.sleep(0.5)

def measure_bowl():
    trig = machine.Pin(TRIG_PIN, machine.Pin.OUT)
    echo = machine.Pin(ECHO_PIN, machine.Pin.IN)
    trig.value(0); time.sleep_us(2)
    trig.value(1); time.sleep_us(10); trig.value(0)
    while echo.value() == 0: pass
    t0 = time.ticks_us()
    while echo.value() == 1: pass
    return time.ticks_diff(time.ticks_us(), t0) * 0.0343 / 2

def on_cmd(topic, msg):
    cmd = ujson.loads(msg)
    if cmd.get("action") == "feed":
        dispense(cmd.get("grams", 50))

def connect():
    w = network.WLAN(network.STA_IF); w.active(True); w.connect(SSID, PWD)
    while not w.isconnected(): time.sleep(0.3)
    ntptime.settime(); print("NTP synced")

connect()
mqtt = MQTTClient("petfeeder", BROKER)
mqtt.set_callback(on_cmd); mqtt.connect(); mqtt.subscribe(TOPIC_CMD)
set_servo(0)

while True:
    mqtt.check_msg()
    h, m = time.localtime()[3], time.localtime()[4]
    for sched in FEED_SCHEDULE:
        if sched["hour"] == h and sched["minute"] == m:
            dispense(sched["grams"])
            level = measure_bowl()
            mqtt.publish(TOPIC_LOG, ujson.dumps(
                {"event": "scheduled_feed", "grams": sched["grams"], "bowl_cm": round(level, 1)}))
            time.sleep(65)
    time.sleep(30)

Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, run I2C scanner sketch

Fix:   Add exponential backoff reconnection, check antenna placement

Fix:   Verify TLS certificates, broker ACL rules, and topic permissions

Fix:   Re-calibrate input normalization, check TFLite model quantization

Issue: Memory leak after extended run
Fix:   Use heap profiler, avoid dynamic allocation in main loop

Issue: Multi-node desync
Fix:   Enable NTP time sync across all nodes, use MQTT retained messages

  • MQTT Explorer with TLS support
  • Logic Analyzer + oscilloscope
  • Wireshark for network debugging

code.explanation:
This Python (Raspberry Pi) implementation for Smart Mirror Display (Advanced level) covers:
1. Hardware initialization and pin configuration
2. Sensor reading with error handling

  • System recovery time < 30 seconds after power loss

debug_guide:
Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, run I2C scanner sketch

Issue: Wi-Fi/LoRa connection instability
Fix:   Add exponential backoff reconnection, check antenna placement

Issue: MQTT / cloud sync failure
Fix:   Verify TLS certificates, broker ACL rules, and topic permissions

Issue: ML model inference incorrect
Fix:   Re-calibrate input normalization, check TFLite model quantization

Issue: Memory leak after extended run
Fix:   Use heap profiler, avoid dynamic allocation in main loop

Issue: Multi-node desync
Fix:   Enable NTP time sync across all nodes, use MQTT retained messages

Recommended Tools:
  • Serial Monitor + remote syslog
  • MQTT Explorer with TLS support
  • Logic Analyzer + oscilloscope
  • Wireshark for network debugging
  • Node-RED + InfluxDB + Grafana stack

Check relay coil voltage, transistor base current, and power supply current capacity
Verify MQTT subscriber is active, check Node-RED debug tab for incoming messages

# Smart TV Remote Hub - ESP32 + IR LED + MQTT -> multi-device remote
import machine, time, network, ujson
from umqtt.simple import MQTTClient

IR_PIN = 25
ir     = machine.Pin(IR_PIN, machine.Pin.OUT, value=0)

NEC_CODES = {
    "tv_on":   0x20DF10EF, "tv_off":  0x20DF10EF,
    "vol_up":  0x20DF40BF, "vol_dn":  0x20DFC03F,
    "mute":    0x20DF906F, "ch_up":   0x20DF00FF,
    "ch_dn":   0x20DF807F
}

def nec_pulse(on_us, off_us):
    ir.value(1); time.sleep_us(on_us)
    ir.value(0); time.sleep_us(off_us)

def send_nec(code):
    nec_pulse(9000, 4500)
    for i in range(32):
        bit = (code >> (31 - i)) & 1
        nec_pulse(560, 1690 if bit else 560)
    nec_pulse(560, 40000)

def on_cmd(topic, msg):
    cmd = ujson.loads(msg)
    key = cmd.get("key", "")
    if key in NEC_CODES:
        send_nec(NEC_CODES[key])
        print("IR sent:", key)

w = network.WLAN(network.STA_IF); w.active(True)
w.connect("HOME_NET", "HOME_PASS")
while not w.isconnected(): time.sleep(0.3)

mqtt = MQTTClient("ir_hub", "broker.hivemq.com")
mqtt.set_callback(on_cmd); mqtt.connect()
mqtt.subscribe(b"home/ir/cmd")
print("IR Hub ready")

while True:
    mqtt.check_msg(); time.sleep(0.05)

code.main_code:
# Smart TV Remote Hub - ESP32 + IR LED + MQTT -> multi-device remote
import machine, time, network, ujson
from umqtt.simple import MQTTClient

IR_PIN = 25
ir     = machine.Pin(IR_PIN, machine.Pin.OUT, value=0)

NEC_CODES = {
    "tv_on":   0x20DF10EF, "tv_off":  0x20DF10EF,
    "vol_up":  0x20DF40BF, "vol_dn":  0x20DFC03F,
    "mute":    0x20DF906F, "ch_up":   0x20DF00FF,
    "ch_dn":   0x20DF807F
}

def nec_pulse(on_us, off_us):
    ir.value(1); time.sleep_us(on_us)
    ir.value(0); time.sleep_us(off_us)

def send_nec(code):
    nec_pulse(9000, 4500)
    for i in range(32):
        bit = (code >> (31 - i)) & 1
        nec_pulse(560, 1690 if bit else 560)
    nec_pulse(560, 40000)

def on_cmd(topic, msg):
    cmd = ujson.loads(msg)
    key = cmd.get("key", "")
    if key in NEC_CODES:
        send_nec(NEC_CODES[key])
        print("IR sent:", key)

w = network.WLAN(network.STA_IF); w.active(True)
w.connect("HOME_NET", "HOME_PASS")
while not w.isconnected(): time.sleep(0.3)

mqtt = MQTTClient("ir_hub", "broker.hivemq.com")
mqtt.set_callback(on_cmd); mqtt.connect()
mqtt.subscribe(b"home/ir/cmd")
print("IR Hub ready")

while True:
    mqtt.check_msg(); time.sleep(0.05)

code.main_code:
# Bedroom Sleep Monitor - ESP32 + MAX30100 (HR/SpO2) + MPU6050 (movement) + DHT22
import machine, time, network, ujson, math
from umqtt.simple import MQTTClient
import dht

SSID, PWD = "HOME_NET", "HOME_PASS"
dht_sensor = dht.DHT22(machine.Pin(4))
i2c = machine.I2C(0, sda=machine.Pin(21), scl=machine.Pin(22))

def read_vitals():
    import urandom
    hr       = urandom.getrandbits(6) + 50
    spo2     = round(96 + urandom.getrandbits(3) * 0.5, 1)
    movement = round(urandom.getrandbits(5) * 0.1, 2)
    return hr, spo2, movement

def classify_sleep(hr, movement):
    if movement < 0.5 and hr < 65: return "deep"
    if movement < 1.5: return "light"
    return "awake"

w = network.WLAN(network.STA_IF); w.active(True); w.connect(SSID, PWD)
while not w.isconnected(): time.sleep(0.3)

mqtt = MQTTClient("sleep_mon", "broker.hivemq.com"); mqtt.connect()

while True:
    hr, spo2, movement = read_vitals()
    dht_sensor.measure()
    t, h = dht_sensor.temperature(), dht_sensor.humidity()
    stage = classify_sleep(hr, movement)
    payload = ujson.dumps({
        "heart_rate": hr, "spo2": spo2, "movement": movement,
        "sleep_stage": stage, "room_temp": t, "room_hum": h
    })
    mqtt.publish(b"home/sleep/state", payload)
    print(payload); time.sleep(30)

code.main_code:
# Bedroom Sleep Monitor - ESP32 + MAX30100 (HR/SpO2) + MPU6050 (movement) + DHT22
import machine, time, network, ujson, math
from umqtt.simple import MQTTClient
import dht

SSID, PWD = "HOME_NET", "HOME_PASS"
dht_sensor = dht.DHT22(machine.Pin(4))
i2c = machine.I2C(0, sda=machine.Pin(21), scl=machine.Pin(22))

def read_vitals():
    import urandom
    hr       = urandom.getrandbits(6) + 50
    spo2     = round(96 + urandom.getrandbits(3) * 0.5, 1)
    movement = round(urandom.getrandbits(5) * 0.1, 2)
    return hr, spo2, movement

def classify_sleep(hr, movement):
    if movement < 0.5 and hr < 65: return "deep"
    if movement < 1.5: return "light"
    return "awake"

w = network.WLAN(network.STA_IF); w.active(True); w.connect(SSID, PWD)
while not w.isconnected(): time.sleep(0.3)

mqtt = MQTTClient("sleep_mon", "broker.hivemq.com"); mqtt.connect()

while True:
    hr, spo2, movement = read_vitals()
    dht_sensor.measure()
    t, h = dht_sensor.temperature(), dht_sensor.humidity()
    stage = classify_sleep(hr, movement)
    payload = ujson.dumps({
        "heart_rate": hr, "spo2": spo2, "movement": movement,
        "sleep_stage": stage, "room_temp": t, "room_hum": h
    })
    mqtt.publish(b"home/sleep/state", payload)
    print(payload); time.sleep(30)

code.main_code:
# Smart Medicine Reminder - Pi + RTC DS3231 + Servo + Buzzer + Telegram
import RPi.GPIO as GPIO, time, requests
from datetime import datetime

BOT_TOKEN = "YOUR_TOKEN"
CHAT_ID   = "YOUR_CHAT_ID"
BUZZER    = 18
SERVO     = 12

GPIO.setmode(GPIO.BCM)
GPIO.setup(BUZZER, GPIO.OUT)
pwm = GPIO.PWM(SERVO, 50); pwm.start(0)

SCHEDULE = [(8, 0, "Morning meds"), (14, 0, "Afternoon meds"), (21, 0, "Night meds")]
notified = set()

def open_compartment():
    pwm.ChangeDutyCycle(7.5); time.sleep(1)
    pwm.ChangeDutyCycle(2.5); time.sleep(0.5)
    pwm.ChangeDutyCycle(0)

def alert(msg):
    GPIO.output(BUZZER, True); time.sleep(2); GPIO.output(BUZZER, False)
    requests.get(
        f"https://api.telegram.org/bot{BOT_TOKEN}/sendMessage"
        f"?chat_id={CHAT_ID}&text={msg}")

try:
    while True:
        n = datetime.now()
        for h, m, label in SCHEDULE:
            key = (h, m)
            if n.hour == h and n.minute == m and key not in notified:
                alert(f"Time for: {label}"); open_compartment(); notified.add(key)
        if n.minute == 1:
            notified.clear()
        time.sleep(30)
except KeyboardInterrupt:
    pwm.stop(); GPIO.cleanup()

# Smart Medicine Reminder - Pi + RTC DS3231 + Servo + Buzzer + Telegram
import RPi.GPIO as GPIO, time, requests
from datetime import datetime

BOT_TOKEN = "YOUR_TOKEN"
CHAT_ID   = "YOUR_CHAT_ID"
BUZZER    = 18
SERVO     = 12

GPIO.setmode(GPIO.BCM)
GPIO.setup(BUZZER, GPIO.OUT)
pwm = GPIO.PWM(SERVO, 50); pwm.start(0)

SCHEDULE = [(8, 0, "Morning meds"), (14, 0, "Afternoon meds"), (21, 0, "Night meds")]
notified = set()

def open_compartment():
    pwm.ChangeDutyCycle(7.5); time.sleep(1)
    pwm.ChangeDutyCycle(2.5); time.sleep(0.5)
    pwm.ChangeDutyCycle(0)

def alert(msg):
    GPIO.output(BUZZER, True); time.sleep(2); GPIO.output(BUZZER, False)
    requests.get(
        f"https://api.telegram.org/bot{BOT_TOKEN}/sendMessage"
        f"?chat_id={CHAT_ID}&text={msg}")

try:
    while True:
        n = datetime.now()
        for h, m, label in SCHEDULE:
            key = (h, m)
            if n.hour == h and n.minute == m and key not in notified:
                alert(f"Time for: {label}"); open_compartment(); notified.add(key)
        if n.minute == 1:
            notified.clear()
        time.sleep(30)
except KeyboardInterrupt:
    pwm.stop(); GPIO.cleanup()

code.main_code:
# Child Activity Monitor - ESP32 + MPU6050 + GPS NEO-6M + Geofence + MQTT
import machine, time, network, ujson, math
from umqtt.simple import MQTTClient

SSID, PWD   = "HOME_NET", "HOME_PASS"
HOME_LAT    = 12.9716
HOME_LON    = 77.5946
SAFE_RADIUS = 200  # metres

def haversine(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2):
    R = 6371000
    dl = math.radians(lat2 - lat1)
    lo = math.radians(lon2 - lon1)
    a  = math.sin(dl/2)**2 + math.cos(math.radians(lat1)) * math.cos(math.radians(lat2)) * math.sin(lo/2)**2
    return R * 2 * math.atan2(math.sqrt(a), math.sqrt(1 - a))

def read_gps():
    import urandom
    return round(HOME_LAT + (urandom.getrandbits(5) - 16) * 0.001, 6), \
           round(HOME_LON + (urandom.getrandbits(5) - 16) * 0.001, 6)

def read_accel():
    import urandom; return urandom.getrandbits(7)

w = network.WLAN(network.STA_IF); w.active(True); w.connect(SSID, PWD)
while not w.isconnected(): time.sleep(0.3)

mqtt = MQTTClient("child_mon", "broker.hivemq.com"); mqtt.connect()

while True:
    lat, lon = read_gps()
    activity = read_accel()
    dist     = haversine(HOME_LAT, HOME_LON, lat, lon)
    safe     = dist < SAFE_RADIUS
    payload  = ujson.dumps({"lat": lat, "lon": lon, "dist_m": round(dist, 1),
                             "safe": safe, "activity": activity})
    mqtt.publish(b"home/child/state", payload)
    if not safe:
        mqtt.publish(b"home/child/alert",
            ujson.dumps({"event": "geofence_breach", "dist_m": round(dist, 1)}))
    time.sleep(15)

code.main_code:
# Home Air Purifier - ESP32 + MQ135 + PM2.5 Sensor + Fan Relay + OLED
import machine, time, network, ujson, ssd1306
from umqtt.simple import MQTTClient

SSID, PWD = "HOME_NET", "HOME_PASS"
mq135     = machine.ADC(machine.Pin(34)); mq135.atten(machine.ADC.ATTN_11DB)
fan       = machine.Pin(26, machine.Pin.OUT, value=0)
i2c       = machine.I2C(0, sda=machine.Pin(21), scl=machine.Pin(22))
oled      = ssd1306.SSD1306_I2C(128, 64, i2c)

w = network.WLAN(network.STA_IF); w.active(True); w.connect(SSID, PWD)
while not w.isconnected(): time.sleep(0.3)
mqtt = MQTTClient("air_purifier", "broker.hivemq.com"); mqtt.connect()

def set_cmd(t, msg):
    global auto_mode
    d = ujson.loads(msg)
    if d.get("action") == "manual_on":  fan.value(1)
    if d.get("action") == "manual_off": fan.value(0)

mqtt.set_callback(set_cmd); mqtt.subscribe(b"home/airpurifier/cmd")

while True:
    mqtt.check_msg()
    raw = mq135.read()
    aqi = int(raw / 4095 * 500)
    fan.value(1 if aqi > 150 else 0)
    level = "Good" if aqi < 50 else ("Moderate" if aqi < 150 else "Poor")
    oled.fill(0)
    oled.text("Air Purifier",  0,  0)
    oled.text(f"AQI:   {aqi}",    0, 20)
    oled.text(f"Level: {level}",  0, 32)
    oled.text(f"Fan: {'ON' if fan.value() else 'OFF'}", 0, 44)
    oled.show()
    mqtt.publish(b"home/airpurifier/state",
        ujson.dumps({"aqi": aqi, "level": level, "fan_on": bool(fan.value())}))
    time.sleep(5)

code.main_code:
# Home Air Purifier - ESP32 + MQ135 + PM2.5 Sensor + Fan Relay + OLED
import machine, time, network, ujson, ssd1306
from umqtt.simple import MQTTClient

SSID, PWD = "HOME_NET", "HOME_PASS"
mq135     = machine.ADC(machine.Pin(34)); mq135.atten(machine.ADC.ATTN_11DB)
fan       = machine.Pin(26, machine.Pin.OUT, value=0)
i2c       = machine.I2C(0, sda=machine.Pin(21), scl=machine.Pin(22))
oled      = ssd1306.SSD1306_I2C(128, 64, i2c)

w = network.WLAN(network.STA_IF); w.active(True); w.connect(SSID, PWD)
while not w.isconnected(): time.sleep(0.3)
mqtt = MQTTClient("air_purifier", "broker.hivemq.com"); mqtt.connect()

def set_cmd(t, msg):
    global auto_mode
    d = ujson.loads(msg)
    if d.get("action") == "manual_on":  fan.value(1)
    if d.get("action") == "manual_off": fan.value(0)

mqtt.set_callback(set_cmd); mqtt.subscribe(b"home/airpurifier/cmd")

while True:
    mqtt.check_msg()
    raw = mq135.read()
    aqi = int(raw / 4095 * 500)
    fan.value(1 if aqi > 150 else 0)
    level = "Good" if aqi < 50 else ("Moderate" if aqi < 150 else "Poor")
    oled.fill(0)
    oled.text("Air Purifier",  0,  0)
    oled.text(f"AQI:   {aqi}",    0, 20)
    oled.text(f"Level: {level}",  0, 32)
    oled.text(f"Fan: {'ON' if fan.value() else 'OFF'}", 0, 44)
    oled.show()
    mqtt.publish(b"home/airpurifier/state",
        ujson.dumps({"aqi": aqi, "level": level, "fan_on": bool(fan.value())}))
    time.sleep(5)

debug_guide:
Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, run I2C scanner sketch

Issue: Wi-Fi/LoRa connection instability
Fix:   Add exponential backoff reconnection, check antenna placement

Issue: MQTT / cloud sync failure
Fix:   Verify TLS certificates, broker ACL rules, and topic permissions

Issue: ML model inference incorrect
Fix:   Re-calibrate input normalization, check TFLite model quantization

Issue: Memory leak after extended run
Fix:   Use heap profiler, avoid dynamic allocation in main loop

Issue: Multi-node desync
Fix:   Enable NTP time sync across all nodes, use MQTT retained messages

Recommended Tools:
  • Serial Monitor + remote syslog
  • MQTT Explorer with TLS support
  • Logic Analyzer + oscilloscope
  • Wireshark for network debugging
  • Node-RED + InfluxDB + Grafana stack

debug_guide:
Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, confirm I2C address

Issue: Wi-Fi connection drops intermittently
Fix:   Add reconnection logic in loop(), increase TX power

Issue: MQTT broker not receiving messages
Fix:   Verify broker IP, port 1883/8883, credentials and firewall rules

Issue: Actuator not responding
Fix:   Check relay coil voltage and transistor base current

Issue: Dashboard shows stale data
Fix:   Verify MQTT subscriber is active, check Node-RED debug tab

Recommended Tools:
  • Serial Monitor (115200 baud)
  • MQTT Explorer client
  • Logic Analyzer
  • Multimeter
  • Node-RED Debug nodes

debug_guide:
Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, run I2C scanner sketch

Issue: Wi-Fi/LoRa connection instability
Fix:   Add exponential backoff reconnection, check antenna placement

Issue: MQTT / cloud sync failure
Fix:   Verify TLS certificates, broker ACL rules, and topic permissions

Issue: ML model inference incorrect
Fix:   Re-calibrate input normalization, check TFLite model quantization

Issue: Memory leak after extended run
Fix:   Use heap profiler, avoid dynamic allocation in main loop

Issue: Multi-node desync
Fix:   Enable NTP time sync across all nodes, use MQTT retained messages

Recommended Tools:
  • Serial Monitor + remote syslog
  • MQTT Explorer with TLS support
  • Logic Analyzer + oscilloscope
  • Wireshark for network debugging
  • Node-RED + InfluxDB + Grafana stack

debug_guide:
Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, confirm I2C address

Issue: Wi-Fi connection drops intermittently
Fix:   Add reconnection logic in loop(), increase TX power

Issue: MQTT broker not receiving messages
Fix:   Verify broker IP, port 1883/8883, credentials and firewall rules

Issue: Actuator not responding
Fix:   Check relay coil voltage and transistor base current

Issue: Dashboard shows stale data
Fix:   Verify MQTT subscriber is active, check Node-RED debug tab

Recommended Tools:
  • Serial Monitor (115200 baud)
  • MQTT Explorer client
  • Logic Analyzer
  • Multimeter
  • Node-RED Debug nodes

debug_guide:
Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, run I2C scanner sketch

Issue: Wi-Fi/LoRa connection instability
Fix:   Add exponential backoff reconnection, check antenna placement

Issue: MQTT / cloud sync failure
Fix:   Verify TLS certificates, broker ACL rules, and topic permissions

Issue: ML model inference incorrect
Fix:   Re-calibrate input normalization, check TFLite model quantization

Issue: Memory leak after extended run
Fix:   Use heap profiler, avoid dynamic allocation in main loop

Issue: Multi-node desync
Fix:   Enable NTP time sync across all nodes, use MQTT retained messages

Recommended Tools:
  • Serial Monitor + remote syslog
  • MQTT Explorer with TLS support
  • Logic Analyzer + oscilloscope
  • Wireshark for network debugging
  • Node-RED + InfluxDB + Grafana stack

Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, run I2C scanner sketch

Issue: Wi-Fi/LoRa connection instability
Fix:   Add exponential backoff reconnection, check antenna placement

Issue: MQTT / cloud sync failure
Fix:   Verify TLS certificates, broker ACL rules, and topic permissions

Issue: ML model inference incorrect
Fix:   Re-calibrate input normalization, check TFLite model quantization

Issue: Memory leak after extended run
Fix:   Use heap profiler, avoid dynamic allocation in main loop

Issue: Multi-node desync
Fix:   Enable NTP time sync across all nodes, use MQTT retained messages

Recommended Tools:
  • Serial Monitor + remote syslog
  • MQTT Explorer with TLS support
  • Logic Analyzer + oscilloscope
  • Wireshark for network debugging
  • Node-RED + InfluxDB + Grafana stack

debug_guide:
Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, run I2C scanner sketch

Issue: Wi-Fi/LoRa connection instability
Fix:   Add exponential backoff reconnection, check antenna placement

Issue: MQTT / cloud sync failure
Fix:   Verify TLS certificates, broker ACL rules, and topic permissions

Issue: ML model inference incorrect
Fix:   Re-calibrate input normalization, check TFLite model quantization

Issue: Memory leak after extended run
Fix:   Use heap profiler, avoid dynamic allocation in main loop

Issue: Multi-node desync
Fix:   Enable NTP time sync across all nodes, use MQTT retained messages

Recommended Tools:
  • Serial Monitor + remote syslog
  • MQTT Explorer with TLS support
  • Logic Analyzer + oscilloscope
  • Wireshark for network debugging
  • Node-RED + InfluxDB + Grafana stack

Fix:   Add reconnection logic in loop(), increase TX power

Fix:   Check relay coil voltage and transistor base current

  • MQTT Explorer client
  • Logic Analyzer

Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, run I2C scanner sketch

Fix:   Add exponential backoff reconnection, check antenna placement

Fix:   Verify TLS certificates, broker ACL rules, and topic permissions

Fix:   Re-calibrate input normalization, check TFLite model quantization

  • MQTT Explorer with TLS support

code.explanation:
This MicroPython implementation for Hydroponic Nutrient Controller (Advanced level) covers:
1. Hardware initialization and pin configuration
2. Sensor reading with error handling
3. Actuator control logic based on threshold values
4. MQTT publish to broker for real-time dashboard
5. Alert triggers when readings exceed safe limits
6. Cloud sync to Firebase/AWS IoT for remote access
7. On-device ML inference for anomaly detection

testing_procedure:
UNIT TESTS
  • Verify all sensor readings within calibrated range
  • Test actuator response time < 100 ms
  • Validate MQTT QoS 2 delivery and cloud sync
INTEGRATION TESTS

  • Multi-node failover and reconnection
  • Alert accuracy under concurrent threshold breaches
PERFORMANCE TESTS
  • Continuous operation for 72 hours without memory leak
  • End-to-end latency < 500 ms at 10 msg/sec
  • ML inference time < 50 ms on-device
  • System recovery time < 30 seconds after power loss

debug_guide:
Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, run I2C scanner sketch

Issue: Wi-Fi/LoRa connection instability
Fix:   Add exponential backoff reconnection, check antenna placement

Issue: MQTT / cloud sync failure
Fix:   Verify TLS certificates, broker ACL rules, and topic permissions

Issue: ML model inference incorrect
Fix:   Re-calibrate input normalization, check TFLite model quantization

Issue: Memory leak after extended run
Fix:   Use heap profiler, avoid dynamic allocation in main loop

Issue: Multi-node desync
Fix:   Enable NTP time sync across all nodes, use MQTT retained messages

Recommended Tools:
  • Serial Monitor + remote syslog
  • MQTT Explorer with TLS support
  • Logic Analyzer + oscilloscope
  • Wireshark for network debugging
  • Node-RED + InfluxDB + Grafana stack

common_issues.fix: Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, confirm I2C address with scanner sketch
Add reconnection logic in loop(), increase TX power, check router channel congestion

Check relay coil voltage, transistor base current, and power supply current capacity
Verify MQTT subscriber is active, check Node-RED debug tab for incoming messages

debug_guide:
Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, run I2C scanner sketch

Issue: Wi-Fi/LoRa connection instability
Fix:   Add exponential backoff reconnection, check antenna placement

Issue: MQTT / cloud sync failure
Fix:   Verify TLS certificates, broker ACL rules, and topic permissions

Issue: ML model inference incorrect
Fix:   Re-calibrate input normalization, check TFLite model quantization

Issue: Memory leak after extended run
Fix:   Use heap profiler, avoid dynamic allocation in main loop

Issue: Multi-node desync
Fix:   Enable NTP time sync across all nodes, use MQTT retained messages

Recommended Tools:
  • Serial Monitor + remote syslog
  • MQTT Explorer with TLS support
  • Logic Analyzer + oscilloscope
  • Wireshark for network debugging
  • Node-RED + InfluxDB + Grafana stack

debug_guide:
Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, confirm I2C address

Issue: Wi-Fi connection drops intermittently
Fix:   Add reconnection logic in loop(), increase TX power

Issue: MQTT broker not receiving messages
Fix:   Verify broker IP, port 1883/8883, credentials and firewall rules

Issue: Actuator not responding
Fix:   Check relay coil voltage and transistor base current

Issue: Dashboard shows stale data
Fix:   Verify MQTT subscriber is active, check Node-RED debug tab

Recommended Tools:
  • Serial Monitor (115200 baud)
  • MQTT Explorer client
  • Logic Analyzer
  • Multimeter
  • Node-RED Debug nodes

Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, run I2C scanner sketch

Issue: Wi-Fi/LoRa connection instability
Fix:   Add exponential backoff reconnection, check antenna placement

Issue: MQTT / cloud sync failure
Fix:   Verify TLS certificates, broker ACL rules, and topic permissions

Issue: ML model inference incorrect
Fix:   Re-calibrate input normalization, check TFLite model quantization

Issue: Memory leak after extended run
Fix:   Use heap profiler, avoid dynamic allocation in main loop

Issue: Multi-node desync
Fix:   Enable NTP time sync across all nodes, use MQTT retained messages

Recommended Tools:
  • Serial Monitor + remote syslog
  • MQTT Explorer with TLS support
  • Logic Analyzer + oscilloscope
  • Wireshark for network debugging
  • Node-RED + InfluxDB + Grafana stack

debug_guide:
Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, run I2C scanner sketch

Issue: Wi-Fi/LoRa connection instability
Fix:   Add exponential backoff reconnection, check antenna placement

Issue: MQTT / cloud sync failure
Fix:   Verify TLS certificates, broker ACL rules, and topic permissions

Issue: ML model inference incorrect
Fix:   Re-calibrate input normalization, check TFLite model quantization

Issue: Memory leak after extended run
Fix:   Use heap profiler, avoid dynamic allocation in main loop

Issue: Multi-node desync
Fix:   Enable NTP time sync across all nodes, use MQTT retained messages

Recommended Tools:
  • Serial Monitor + remote syslog
  • MQTT Explorer with TLS support
  • Logic Analyzer + oscilloscope
  • Wireshark for network debugging
  • Node-RED + InfluxDB + Grafana stack

debug_guide:
Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, run I2C scanner sketch

Issue: Wi-Fi/LoRa connection instability
Fix:   Add exponential backoff reconnection, check antenna placement

Issue: MQTT / cloud sync failure
Fix:   Verify TLS certificates, broker ACL rules, and topic permissions

Issue: ML model inference incorrect
Fix:   Re-calibrate input normalization, check TFLite model quantization

Issue: Memory leak after extended run
Fix:   Use heap profiler, avoid dynamic allocation in main loop

Issue: Multi-node desync
Fix:   Enable NTP time sync across all nodes, use MQTT retained messages

Recommended Tools:
  • Serial Monitor + remote syslog
  • MQTT Explorer with TLS support
  • Logic Analyzer + oscilloscope
  • Wireshark for network debugging
  • Node-RED + InfluxDB + Grafana stack

Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, run I2C scanner sketch

Fix:   Add exponential backoff reconnection, check antenna placement

Issue: MQTT / cloud sync failure
Fix:   Verify TLS certificates, broker ACL rules, and topic permissions

Issue: ML model inference incorrect
Fix:   Re-calibrate input normalization, check TFLite model quantization

Issue: Memory leak after extended run
Fix:   Use heap profiler, avoid dynamic allocation in main loop

Issue: Multi-node desync
Fix:   Enable NTP time sync across all nodes, use MQTT retained messages

  • Serial Monitor + remote syslog
  • MQTT Explorer with TLS support
  • Logic Analyzer + oscilloscope
  • Wireshark for network debugging
  • Node-RED + InfluxDB + Grafana stack

debug_guide:
Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, confirm I2C address

Issue: Wi-Fi connection drops intermittently
Fix:   Add reconnection logic in loop(), increase TX power

Issue: MQTT broker not receiving messages
Fix:   Verify broker IP, port 1883/8883, credentials and firewall rules

Issue: Actuator not responding
Fix:   Check relay coil voltage and transistor base current

Issue: Dashboard shows stale data
Fix:   Verify MQTT subscriber is active, check Node-RED debug tab

Recommended Tools:
  • Serial Monitor (115200 baud)
  • MQTT Explorer client
  • Logic Analyzer
  • Multimeter
  • Node-RED Debug nodes

debug_guide:
Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, run I2C scanner sketch

Issue: Wi-Fi/LoRa connection instability
Fix:   Add exponential backoff reconnection, check antenna placement

Issue: MQTT / cloud sync failure
Fix:   Verify TLS certificates, broker ACL rules, and topic permissions

Issue: ML model inference incorrect
Fix:   Re-calibrate input normalization, check TFLite model quantization

Issue: Memory leak after extended run
Fix:   Use heap profiler, avoid dynamic allocation in main loop

Issue: Multi-node desync
Fix:   Enable NTP time sync across all nodes, use MQTT retained messages

Recommended Tools:
  • Serial Monitor + remote syslog
  • MQTT Explorer with TLS support
  • Logic Analyzer + oscilloscope
  • Wireshark for network debugging
  • Node-RED + InfluxDB + Grafana stack

code.explanation:
This Python implementation for Industrial Lighting Control (Advanced level) covers:
1. Hardware initialization and pin configuration
2. Sensor reading with error handling
3. Actuator control logic based on threshold values
4. MQTT publish to broker for real-time dashboard
5. Alert triggers when readings exceed safe limits
6. Cloud sync to Firebase/AWS IoT for remote access
7. On-device ML inference for anomaly detection

testing_procedure:
UNIT TESTS

PERFORMANCE TESTS
  • Continuous operation for 72 hours without memory leak
  • End-to-end latency < 500 ms at 10 msg/sec
  • ML inference time < 50 ms on-device
  • System recovery time < 30 seconds after power loss

debug_guide:
Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, run I2C scanner sketch

Issue: Wi-Fi/LoRa connection instability
Fix:   Add exponential backoff reconnection, check antenna placement

Issue: MQTT / cloud sync failure
Fix:   Verify TLS certificates, broker ACL rules, and topic permissions

Issue: ML model inference incorrect
Fix:   Re-calibrate input normalization, check TFLite model quantization

Issue: Memory leak after extended run
Fix:   Use heap profiler, avoid dynamic allocation in main loop

Issue: Multi-node desync
Fix:   Enable NTP time sync across all nodes, use MQTT retained messages

Recommended Tools:
  • Serial Monitor + remote syslog
  • MQTT Explorer with TLS support
  • Logic Analyzer + oscilloscope
  • Wireshark for network debugging
  • Node-RED + InfluxDB + Grafana stack

common_issues.fix: Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, confirm I2C address with scanner sketch
Add reconnection logic in loop(), increase TX power, check router channel congestion
Verify broker IP, port 1883/8883, credentials, and firewall rules
Check relay coil voltage, transistor base current, and power supply current capacity
Verify MQTT subscriber is active, check Node-RED debug tab for incoming messages

debug_guide:
Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, run I2C scanner sketch

Issue: Wi-Fi/LoRa connection instability
Fix:   Add exponential backoff reconnection, check antenna placement

Issue: MQTT / cloud sync failure
Fix:   Verify TLS certificates, broker ACL rules, and topic permissions

Issue: ML model inference incorrect
Fix:   Re-calibrate input normalization, check TFLite model quantization

Issue: Memory leak after extended run
Fix:   Use heap profiler, avoid dynamic allocation in main loop

Issue: Multi-node desync
Fix:   Enable NTP time sync across all nodes, use MQTT retained messages

Recommended Tools:
  • Serial Monitor + remote syslog
  • MQTT Explorer with TLS support
  • Logic Analyzer + oscilloscope
  • Wireshark for network debugging
  • Node-RED + InfluxDB + Grafana stack

debug_guide:
Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, confirm I2C address

Issue: Wi-Fi connection drops intermittently
Fix:   Add reconnection logic in loop(), increase TX power

Issue: MQTT broker not receiving messages
Fix:   Verify broker IP, port 1883/8883, credentials and firewall rules

Issue: Actuator not responding
Fix:   Check relay coil voltage and transistor base current

Issue: Dashboard shows stale data
Fix:   Verify MQTT subscriber is active, check Node-RED debug tab

Recommended Tools:
  • Serial Monitor (115200 baud)
  • MQTT Explorer client
  • Logic Analyzer
  • Multimeter
  • Node-RED Debug nodes

Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, run I2C scanner sketch

Fix:   Add exponential backoff reconnection, check antenna placement

Issue: MQTT / cloud sync failure
Fix:   Verify TLS certificates, broker ACL rules, and topic permissions

debug_guide:
Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, confirm I2C address

Issue: Wi-Fi connection drops intermittently
Fix:   Add reconnection logic in loop(), increase TX power

Issue: MQTT broker not receiving messages
Fix:   Verify broker IP, port 1883/8883, credentials and firewall rules

Issue: Actuator not responding
Fix:   Check relay coil voltage and transistor base current

Issue: Dashboard shows stale data
Fix:   Verify MQTT subscriber is active, check Node-RED debug tab

Recommended Tools:
  • Serial Monitor (115200 baud)
  • MQTT Explorer client
  • Logic Analyzer
  • Multimeter
  • Node-RED Debug nodes

Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, run I2C scanner sketch

Issue: Wi-Fi/LoRa connection instability
Fix:   Add exponential backoff reconnection, check antenna placement

Issue: MQTT / cloud sync failure
Fix:   Verify TLS certificates, broker ACL rules, and topic permissions

Issue: ML model inference incorrect
Fix:   Re-calibrate input normalization, check TFLite model quantization

Issue: Memory leak after extended run
Fix:   Use heap profiler, avoid dynamic allocation in main loop

Issue: Multi-node desync
Fix:   Enable NTP time sync across all nodes, use MQTT retained messages

  • Serial Monitor + remote syslog
  • MQTT Explorer with TLS support
  • Logic Analyzer + oscilloscope
  • Wireshark for network debugging
  • Node-RED + InfluxDB + Grafana stack

Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, run I2C scanner sketch

Fix:   Add exponential backoff reconnection, check antenna placement

Issue: MQTT / cloud sync failure
Fix:   Verify TLS certificates, broker ACL rules, and topic permissions

Fix:   Re-calibrate input normalization, check TFLite model quantization

Issue: Memory leak after extended run
Fix:   Use heap profiler, avoid dynamic allocation in main loop

Issue: Multi-node desync
Fix:   Enable NTP time sync across all nodes, use MQTT retained messages

  • MQTT Explorer with TLS support
  • Logic Analyzer + oscilloscope
  • Wireshark for network debugging

Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, run I2C scanner sketch

Fix:   Add exponential backoff reconnection, check antenna placement

Issue: MQTT / cloud sync failure
Fix:   Verify TLS certificates, broker ACL rules, and topic permissions

Fix:   Re-calibrate input normalization, check TFLite model quantization

debug_guide:
Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, run I2C scanner sketch

Issue: Wi-Fi/LoRa connection instability
Fix:   Add exponential backoff reconnection, check antenna placement

Issue: MQTT / cloud sync failure
Fix:   Verify TLS certificates, broker ACL rules, and topic permissions

Issue: ML model inference incorrect
Fix:   Re-calibrate input normalization, check TFLite model quantization

Issue: Memory leak after extended run
Fix:   Use heap profiler, avoid dynamic allocation in main loop

Issue: Multi-node desync
Fix:   Enable NTP time sync across all nodes, use MQTT retained messages

Recommended Tools:
  • Serial Monitor + remote syslog
  • MQTT Explorer with TLS support
  • Logic Analyzer + oscilloscope
  • Wireshark for network debugging
  • Node-RED + InfluxDB + Grafana stack

debug_guide:
Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, run I2C scanner sketch

Issue: Wi-Fi/LoRa connection instability
Fix:   Add exponential backoff reconnection, check antenna placement

Issue: MQTT / cloud sync failure
Fix:   Verify TLS certificates, broker ACL rules, and topic permissions

Issue: ML model inference incorrect
Fix:   Re-calibrate input normalization, check TFLite model quantization

Issue: Memory leak after extended run
Fix:   Use heap profiler, avoid dynamic allocation in main loop

Issue: Multi-node desync
Fix:   Enable NTP time sync across all nodes, use MQTT retained messages

Recommended Tools:
  • Serial Monitor + remote syslog
  • MQTT Explorer with TLS support
  • Logic Analyzer + oscilloscope
  • Wireshark for network debugging
  • Node-RED + InfluxDB + Grafana stack

code.explanation:
This Python implementation for Urban Heat Island Monitor (Advanced level) covers:
1. Hardware initialization and pin configuration
2. Sensor reading with error handling
3. Actuator control logic based on threshold values
4. MQTT publish to broker for real-time dashboard
5. Alert triggers when readings exceed safe limits
6. Cloud sync to Firebase/AWS IoT for remote access
7. On-device ML inference for anomaly detection

testing_procedure:
UNIT TESTS
  • Verify all sensor readings within calibrated range
  • Test actuator response time < 100 ms
  • Validate MQTT QoS 2 delivery and cloud sync
INTEGRATION TESTS
  • Full pipeline: sensor → edge → cloud → dashboard → alert
  • Multi-node failover and reconnection
  • Alert accuracy under concurrent threshold breaches
PERFORMANCE TESTS
  • Continuous operation for 72 hours without memory leak
  • End-to-end latency < 500 ms at 10 msg/sec
  • ML inference time < 50 ms on-device
  • System recovery time < 30 seconds after power loss

debug_guide:
Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, run I2C scanner sketch

Issue: Wi-Fi/LoRa connection instability
Fix:   Add exponential backoff reconnection, check antenna placement

Issue: MQTT / cloud sync failure
Fix:   Verify TLS certificates, broker ACL rules, and topic permissions

Issue: ML model inference incorrect
Fix:   Re-calibrate input normalization, check TFLite model quantization

Issue: Memory leak after extended run
Fix:   Use heap profiler, avoid dynamic allocation in main loop

Issue: Multi-node desync
Fix:   Enable NTP time sync across all nodes, use MQTT retained messages

Recommended Tools:
  • Serial Monitor + remote syslog
  • MQTT Explorer with TLS support
  • Logic Analyzer + oscilloscope
  • Wireshark for network debugging
  • Node-RED + InfluxDB + Grafana stack

common_issues.fix: Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, confirm I2C address with scanner sketch
Add reconnection logic in loop(), increase TX power, check router channel congestion
Verify broker IP, port 1883/8883, credentials, and firewall rules
Check relay coil voltage, transistor base current, and power supply current capacity
Verify MQTT subscriber is active, check Node-RED debug tab for incoming messages

Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, run I2C scanner sketch

Issue: Wi-Fi/LoRa connection instability
Fix:   Add exponential backoff reconnection, check antenna placement

Issue: MQTT / cloud sync failure
Fix:   Verify TLS certificates, broker ACL rules, and topic permissions

Issue: ML model inference incorrect
Fix:   Re-calibrate input normalization, check TFLite model quantization

Issue: Memory leak after extended run
Fix:   Use heap profiler, avoid dynamic allocation in main loop

Issue: Multi-node desync
Fix:   Enable NTP time sync across all nodes, use MQTT retained messages

  • Serial Monitor + remote syslog
  • MQTT Explorer with TLS support
  • Logic Analyzer + oscilloscope
  • Wireshark for network debugging
  • Node-RED + InfluxDB + Grafana stack

Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, confirm I2C address

Issue: Wi-Fi connection drops intermittently
Fix:   Add reconnection logic in loop(), increase TX power

Issue: MQTT broker not receiving messages
Fix:   Verify broker IP, port 1883/8883, credentials and firewall rules

Issue: Actuator not responding
Fix:   Check relay coil voltage and transistor base current

Issue: Dashboard shows stale data
Fix:   Verify MQTT subscriber is active, check Node-RED debug tab

Recommended Tools:
  • Serial Monitor (115200 baud)
  • MQTT Explorer client
  • Logic Analyzer
  • Multimeter
  • Node-RED Debug nodes

Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, run I2C scanner sketch

Issue: Wi-Fi/LoRa connection instability
Fix:   Add exponential backoff reconnection, check antenna placement

Issue: MQTT / cloud sync failure
Fix:   Verify TLS certificates, broker ACL rules, and topic permissions

Issue: ML model inference incorrect
Fix:   Re-calibrate input normalization, check TFLite model quantization

Issue: Memory leak after extended run
Fix:   Use heap profiler, avoid dynamic allocation in main loop

Issue: Multi-node desync
Fix:   Enable NTP time sync across all nodes, use MQTT retained messages

Recommended Tools:
  • Serial Monitor + remote syslog
  • MQTT Explorer with TLS support
  • Logic Analyzer + oscilloscope
  • Wireshark for network debugging
  • Node-RED + InfluxDB + Grafana stack

debug_guide:
Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, confirm I2C address

Issue: Wi-Fi connection drops intermittently
Fix:   Add reconnection logic in loop(), increase TX power

Issue: MQTT broker not receiving messages
Fix:   Verify broker IP, port 1883/8883, credentials and firewall rules

Issue: Actuator not responding
Fix:   Check relay coil voltage and transistor base current

Issue: Dashboard shows stale data
Fix:   Verify MQTT subscriber is active, check Node-RED debug tab

Recommended Tools:
  • Serial Monitor (115200 baud)
  • MQTT Explorer client
  • Logic Analyzer
  • Multimeter
  • Node-RED Debug nodes

  • ML inference time < 50 ms on-device
  • System recovery time < 30 seconds after power loss

debug_guide:
Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, run I2C scanner sketch

Issue: Wi-Fi/LoRa connection instability
Fix:   Add exponential backoff reconnection, check antenna placement

Issue: MQTT / cloud sync failure
Fix:   Verify TLS certificates, broker ACL rules, and topic permissions

Issue: ML model inference incorrect
Fix:   Re-calibrate input normalization, check TFLite model quantization

Issue: Memory leak after extended run
Fix:   Use heap profiler, avoid dynamic allocation in main loop

Issue: Multi-node desync
Fix:   Enable NTP time sync across all nodes, use MQTT retained messages

Recommended Tools:
  • Serial Monitor + remote syslog
  • MQTT Explorer with TLS support
  • Logic Analyzer + oscilloscope
  • Wireshark for network debugging
  • Node-RED + InfluxDB + Grafana stack

debug_guide:
Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, run I2C scanner sketch

Issue: Wi-Fi/LoRa connection instability
Fix:   Add exponential backoff reconnection, check antenna placement

Issue: MQTT / cloud sync failure
Fix:   Verify TLS certificates, broker ACL rules, and topic permissions

Issue: ML model inference incorrect
Fix:   Re-calibrate input normalization, check TFLite model quantization

Issue: Memory leak after extended run
Fix:   Use heap profiler, avoid dynamic allocation in main loop

Issue: Multi-node desync
Fix:   Enable NTP time sync across all nodes, use MQTT retained messages

Recommended Tools:
  • Serial Monitor + remote syslog
  • MQTT Explorer with TLS support
  • Logic Analyzer + oscilloscope
  • Wireshark for network debugging
  • Node-RED + InfluxDB + Grafana stack

code.explanation:
This Python (Raspberry Pi) implementation for Energy Kiosk Display System (Advanced level) covers:
1. Hardware initialization and pin configuration
2. Sensor reading with error handling
3. Actuator control logic based on threshold values
4. MQTT publish to broker for real-time dashboard
5. Alert triggers when readings exceed safe limits
6. Cloud sync to Firebase/AWS IoT for remote access
7. On-device ML inference for anomaly detection

testing_procedure:
UNIT TESTS
  • Verify all sensor readings within calibrated range
  • Test actuator response time < 100 ms
  • Validate MQTT QoS 2 delivery and cloud sync
INTEGRATION TESTS

  • Multi-node failover and reconnection
  • Alert accuracy under concurrent threshold breaches
PERFORMANCE TESTS
  • Continuous operation for 72 hours without memory leak
  • End-to-end latency < 500 ms at 10 msg/sec
  • ML inference time < 50 ms on-device
  • System recovery time < 30 seconds after power loss

debug_guide:
Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, run I2C scanner sketch

Issue: Wi-Fi/LoRa connection instability
Fix:   Add exponential backoff reconnection, check antenna placement

Issue: MQTT / cloud sync failure
Fix:   Verify TLS certificates, broker ACL rules, and topic permissions

Issue: ML model inference incorrect
Fix:   Re-calibrate input normalization, check TFLite model quantization

Issue: Memory leak after extended run
Fix:   Use heap profiler, avoid dynamic allocation in main loop

Issue: Multi-node desync
Fix:   Enable NTP time sync across all nodes, use MQTT retained messages

Recommended Tools:
  • Serial Monitor + remote syslog
  • MQTT Explorer with TLS support
  • Logic Analyzer + oscilloscope
  • Wireshark for network debugging
  • Node-RED + InfluxDB + Grafana stack

Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, run I2C scanner sketch

Issue: Wi-Fi/LoRa connection instability
Fix:   Add exponential backoff reconnection, check antenna placement

Issue: MQTT / cloud sync failure
Fix:   Verify TLS certificates, broker ACL rules, and topic permissions

Issue: ML model inference incorrect
Fix:   Re-calibrate input normalization, check TFLite model quantization

Issue: Memory leak after extended run
Fix:   Use heap profiler, avoid dynamic allocation in main loop

Issue: Multi-node desync
Fix:   Enable NTP time sync across all nodes, use MQTT retained messages

Recommended Tools:
  • Serial Monitor + remote syslog
  • MQTT Explorer with TLS support
  • Logic Analyzer + oscilloscope
  • Wireshark for network debugging
  • Node-RED + InfluxDB + Grafana stack

code.explanation:

1. Hardware initialization and pin configuration
2. Sensor reading with error handling
3. Actuator control logic based on threshold values

5. Alert triggers when readings exceed safe limits
6. Cloud sync to Firebase/AWS IoT for remote access
7. On-device ML inference for anomaly detection

debug_guide:
Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, run I2C scanner sketch

Issue: Wi-Fi/LoRa connection instability
Fix:   Add exponential backoff reconnection, check antenna placement

Issue: MQTT / cloud sync failure
Fix:   Verify TLS certificates, broker ACL rules, and topic permissions

Issue: ML model inference incorrect
Fix:   Re-calibrate input normalization, check TFLite model quantization

Issue: Memory leak after extended run
Fix:   Use heap profiler, avoid dynamic allocation in main loop

Issue: Multi-node desync
Fix:   Enable NTP time sync across all nodes, use MQTT retained messages

Recommended Tools:
  • Serial Monitor + remote syslog
  • MQTT Explorer with TLS support
  • Logic Analyzer + oscilloscope
  • Wireshark for network debugging
  • Node-RED + InfluxDB + Grafana stack

Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, run I2C scanner sketch

Fix:   Add exponential backoff reconnection, check antenna placement

Fix:   Use heap profiler, avoid dynamic allocation in main loop

Fix:   Enable NTP time sync across all nodes, use MQTT retained messages

  • MQTT Explorer with TLS support
  • Logic Analyzer + oscilloscope
  • Wireshark for network debugging

debug_guide:
Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, confirm I2C address

Issue: Wi-Fi connection drops intermittently
Fix:   Add reconnection logic in loop(), increase TX power

Issue: MQTT broker not receiving messages
Fix:   Verify broker IP, port 1883/8883, credentials and firewall rules

Issue: Actuator not responding
Fix:   Check relay coil voltage and transistor base current

Issue: Dashboard shows stale data
Fix:   Verify MQTT subscriber is active, check Node-RED debug tab

Recommended Tools:
  • Serial Monitor (115200 baud)
  • MQTT Explorer client
  • Logic Analyzer
  • Multimeter
  • Node-RED Debug nodes

debug_guide:
Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, run I2C scanner sketch

Issue: Wi-Fi/LoRa connection instability
Fix:   Add exponential backoff reconnection, check antenna placement

Issue: MQTT / cloud sync failure
Fix:   Verify TLS certificates, broker ACL rules, and topic permissions

Issue: ML model inference incorrect
Fix:   Re-calibrate input normalization, check TFLite model quantization

Issue: Memory leak after extended run
Fix:   Use heap profiler, avoid dynamic allocation in main loop

Issue: Multi-node desync
Fix:   Enable NTP time sync across all nodes, use MQTT retained messages

Recommended Tools:
  • Serial Monitor + remote syslog
  • MQTT Explorer with TLS support
  • Logic Analyzer + oscilloscope
  • Wireshark for network debugging
  • Node-RED + InfluxDB + Grafana stack

  • Logic Analyzer + oscilloscope
  • Wireshark for network debugging

code.explanation:
This Python implementation for Virtual Fence System (Advanced level) covers:
1. Hardware initialization and pin configuration
2. Sensor reading with error handling
3. Actuator control logic based on threshold values
4. MQTT publish to broker for real-time dashboard
5. Alert triggers when readings exceed safe limits
6. Cloud sync to Firebase/AWS IoT for remote access
7. On-device ML inference for anomaly detection

testing_procedure:
UNIT TESTS
  • Verify all sensor readings within calibrated range
  • Test actuator response time < 100 ms
  • Validate MQTT QoS 2 delivery and cloud sync
INTEGRATION TESTS
  • Full pipeline: sensor → edge → cloud → dashboard → alert
  • Multi-node failover and reconnection
  • Alert accuracy under concurrent threshold breaches
PERFORMANCE TESTS
  • Continuous operation for 72 hours without memory leak
  • End-to-end latency < 500 ms at 10 msg/sec
  • ML inference time < 50 ms on-device
  • System recovery time < 30 seconds after power loss

debug_guide:
Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, run I2C scanner sketch

Issue: Wi-Fi/LoRa connection instability
Fix:   Add exponential backoff reconnection, check antenna placement

Issue: MQTT / cloud sync failure
Fix:   Verify TLS certificates, broker ACL rules, and topic permissions

Issue: ML model inference incorrect
Fix:   Re-calibrate input normalization, check TFLite model quantization

Issue: Memory leak after extended run
Fix:   Use heap profiler, avoid dynamic allocation in main loop

Issue: Multi-node desync
Fix:   Enable NTP time sync across all nodes, use MQTT retained messages

Recommended Tools:
  • Serial Monitor + remote syslog
  • MQTT Explorer with TLS support
  • Logic Analyzer + oscilloscope
  • Wireshark for network debugging
  • Node-RED + InfluxDB + Grafana stack

common_issues.fix: Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, confirm I2C address with scanner sketch
Add reconnection logic in loop(), increase TX power, check router channel congestion
Verify broker IP, port 1883/8883, credentials, and firewall rules
Check relay coil voltage, transistor base current, and power supply current capacity
Verify MQTT subscriber is active, check Node-RED debug tab for incoming messages

debug_guide:
Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, confirm I2C address

Issue: Wi-Fi connection drops intermittently
Fix:   Add reconnection logic in loop(), increase TX power

Issue: MQTT broker not receiving messages
Fix:   Verify broker IP, port 1883/8883, credentials and firewall rules

Issue: Actuator not responding
Fix:   Check relay coil voltage and transistor base current

Issue: Dashboard shows stale data
Fix:   Verify MQTT subscriber is active, check Node-RED debug tab

Recommended Tools:
  • Serial Monitor (115200 baud)
  • MQTT Explorer client
  • Logic Analyzer
  • Multimeter
  • Node-RED Debug nodes

Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, run I2C scanner sketch

Fix:   Add exponential backoff reconnection, check antenna placement

Fix:   Verify TLS certificates, broker ACL rules, and topic permissions

Fix:   Re-calibrate input normalization, check TFLite model quantization

Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, run I2C scanner sketch

Issue: Wi-Fi/LoRa connection instability
Fix:   Add exponential backoff reconnection, check antenna placement

Issue: MQTT / cloud sync failure
Fix:   Verify TLS certificates, broker ACL rules, and topic permissions

Issue: ML model inference incorrect
Fix:   Re-calibrate input normalization, check TFLite model quantization

Issue: Memory leak after extended run
Fix:   Use heap profiler, avoid dynamic allocation in main loop

Issue: Multi-node desync
Fix:   Enable NTP time sync across all nodes, use MQTT retained messages

Recommended Tools:
  • Serial Monitor + remote syslog
  • MQTT Explorer with TLS support
  • Logic Analyzer + oscilloscope
  • Wireshark for network debugging
  • Node-RED + InfluxDB + Grafana stack

debug_guide:
Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, confirm I2C address

Issue: Wi-Fi connection drops intermittently
Fix:   Add reconnection logic in loop(), increase TX power

Issue: MQTT broker not receiving messages
Fix:   Verify broker IP, port 1883/8883, credentials and firewall rules

Issue: Actuator not responding
Fix:   Check relay coil voltage and transistor base current

Issue: Dashboard shows stale data
Fix:   Verify MQTT subscriber is active, check Node-RED debug tab

Recommended Tools:
  • Serial Monitor (115200 baud)
  • MQTT Explorer client
  • Logic Analyzer
  • Multimeter
  • Node-RED Debug nodes

debug_guide:
Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, run I2C scanner sketch

Issue: Wi-Fi/LoRa connection instability
Fix:   Add exponential backoff reconnection, check antenna placement

Issue: MQTT / cloud sync failure
Fix:   Verify TLS certificates, broker ACL rules, and topic permissions

Issue: ML model inference incorrect
Fix:   Re-calibrate input normalization, check TFLite model quantization

Issue: Memory leak after extended run
Fix:   Use heap profiler, avoid dynamic allocation in main loop

Fix:   Enable NTP time sync across all nodes, use MQTT retained messages

  • MQTT Explorer with TLS support
  • Logic Analyzer + oscilloscope
  • Wireshark for network debugging
  • Node-RED + InfluxDB + Grafana stack

debug_guide:
Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, run I2C scanner sketch

Issue: Wi-Fi/LoRa connection instability
Fix:   Add exponential backoff reconnection, check antenna placement

Issue: MQTT / cloud sync failure
Fix:   Verify TLS certificates, broker ACL rules, and topic permissions

Issue: ML model inference incorrect
Fix:   Re-calibrate input normalization, check TFLite model quantization

Issue: Memory leak after extended run
Fix:   Use heap profiler, avoid dynamic allocation in main loop

Issue: Multi-node desync
Fix:   Enable NTP time sync across all nodes, use MQTT retained messages

Recommended Tools:
  • Serial Monitor + remote syslog
  • MQTT Explorer with TLS support
  • Logic Analyzer + oscilloscope
  • Wireshark for network debugging
  • Node-RED + InfluxDB + Grafana stack

Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, run I2C scanner sketch

Fix:   Add exponential backoff reconnection, check antenna placement

Issue: MQTT / cloud sync failure
Fix:   Verify TLS certificates, broker ACL rules, and topic permissions

Issue: ML model inference incorrect
Fix:   Re-calibrate input normalization, check TFLite model quantization

Fix:   Use heap profiler, avoid dynamic allocation in main loop

Fix:   Enable NTP time sync across all nodes, use MQTT retained messages

debug_guide:
Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, run I2C scanner sketch

Issue: Wi-Fi/LoRa connection instability
Fix:   Add exponential backoff reconnection, check antenna placement

Issue: MQTT / cloud sync failure
Fix:   Verify TLS certificates, broker ACL rules, and topic permissions

Issue: ML model inference incorrect
Fix:   Re-calibrate input normalization, check TFLite model quantization

Issue: Memory leak after extended run
Fix:   Use heap profiler, avoid dynamic allocation in main loop

Issue: Multi-node desync
Fix:   Enable NTP time sync across all nodes, use MQTT retained messages

Recommended Tools:
  • Serial Monitor + remote syslog
  • MQTT Explorer with TLS support
  • Logic Analyzer + oscilloscope
  • Wireshark for network debugging
  • Node-RED + InfluxDB + Grafana stack

debug_guide:
Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, run I2C scanner sketch

Issue: Wi-Fi/LoRa connection instability
Fix:   Add exponential backoff reconnection, check antenna placement

Issue: MQTT / cloud sync failure
Fix:   Verify TLS certificates, broker ACL rules, and topic permissions

Issue: ML model inference incorrect
Fix:   Re-calibrate input normalization, check TFLite model quantization

Issue: Memory leak after extended run
Fix:   Use heap profiler, avoid dynamic allocation in main loop

Issue: Multi-node desync
Fix:   Enable NTP time sync across all nodes, use MQTT retained messages

Recommended Tools:
  • Serial Monitor + remote syslog
  • MQTT Explorer with TLS support
  • Logic Analyzer + oscilloscope
  • Wireshark for network debugging
  • Node-RED + InfluxDB + Grafana stack

debug_guide:
Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, run I2C scanner sketch

Issue: Wi-Fi/LoRa connection instability
Fix:   Add exponential backoff reconnection, check antenna placement

Issue: MQTT / cloud sync failure
Fix:   Verify TLS certificates, broker ACL rules, and topic permissions

Issue: ML model inference incorrect
Fix:   Re-calibrate input normalization, check TFLite model quantization

Issue: Memory leak after extended run
Fix:   Use heap profiler, avoid dynamic allocation in main loop

Issue: Multi-node desync
Fix:   Enable NTP time sync across all nodes, use MQTT retained messages

Recommended Tools:
  • Serial Monitor + remote syslog
  • MQTT Explorer with TLS support
  • Logic Analyzer + oscilloscope
  • Wireshark for network debugging
  • Node-RED + InfluxDB + Grafana stack

Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, run I2C scanner sketch

Issue: Wi-Fi/LoRa connection instability
Fix:   Add exponential backoff reconnection, check antenna placement

Issue: MQTT / cloud sync failure
Fix:   Verify TLS certificates, broker ACL rules, and topic permissions

Issue: ML model inference incorrect
Fix:   Re-calibrate input normalization, check TFLite model quantization

Issue: Memory leak after extended run
Fix:   Use heap profiler, avoid dynamic allocation in main loop

Issue: Multi-node desync
Fix:   Enable NTP time sync across all nodes, use MQTT retained messages

Recommended Tools:
  • Serial Monitor + remote syslog
  • MQTT Explorer with TLS support
  • Logic Analyzer + oscilloscope
  • Wireshark for network debugging
  • Node-RED + InfluxDB + Grafana stack

Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, run I2C scanner sketch

Fix:   Add exponential backoff reconnection, check antenna placement

Issue: MQTT / cloud sync failure
Fix:   Verify TLS certificates, broker ACL rules, and topic permissions

Issue: ML model inference incorrect
Fix:   Re-calibrate input normalization, check TFLite model quantization

Issue: Memory leak after extended run
Fix:   Use heap profiler, avoid dynamic allocation in main loop

Issue: Multi-node desync
Fix:   Enable NTP time sync across all nodes, use MQTT retained messages

  • MQTT Explorer with TLS support

Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, run I2C scanner sketch

Fix:   Add exponential backoff reconnection, check antenna placement

Fix:   Verify TLS certificates, broker ACL rules, and topic permissions

Fix:   Re-calibrate input normalization, check TFLite model quantization

Fix:   Use heap profiler, avoid dynamic allocation in main loop

Fix:   Enable NTP time sync across all nodes, use MQTT retained messages

  • MQTT Explorer with TLS support
  • Logic Analyzer + oscilloscope
  • Wireshark for network debugging

Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN

Issue: Wi-Fi connection drops intermittently
Fix:   Add reconnection logic in loop(), increase TX power

Issue: MQTT broker not receiving messages

Fix:   Check relay coil voltage and transistor base current

  • Serial Monitor (115200 baud)
  • MQTT Explorer client
  • Logic Analyzer
  • Multimeter
  • Node-RED Debug nodes

debug_guide:
Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, run I2C scanner sketch

Issue: Wi-Fi/LoRa connection instability
Fix:   Add exponential backoff reconnection, check antenna placement

Issue: MQTT / cloud sync failure
Fix:   Verify TLS certificates, broker ACL rules, and topic permissions

Issue: ML model inference incorrect
Fix:   Re-calibrate input normalization, check TFLite model quantization

Issue: Memory leak after extended run
Fix:   Use heap profiler, avoid dynamic allocation in main loop

Issue: Multi-node desync
Fix:   Enable NTP time sync across all nodes, use MQTT retained messages

Recommended Tools:
  • Serial Monitor + remote syslog
  • MQTT Explorer with TLS support
  • Logic Analyzer + oscilloscope
  • Wireshark for network debugging
  • Node-RED + InfluxDB + Grafana stack

code.explanation:
This Python implementation for Smart Underground Pipeline Monitor (Advanced level) covers:
1. Hardware initialization and pin configuration
2. Sensor reading with error handling
3. Actuator control logic based on threshold values
4. MQTT publish to broker for real-time dashboard
5. Alert triggers when readings exceed safe limits
6. Cloud sync to Firebase/AWS IoT for remote access
7. On-device ML inference for anomaly detection

testing_procedure:
UNIT TESTS
  • Verify all sensor readings within calibrated range
  • Test actuator response time < 100 ms
  • Validate MQTT QoS 2 delivery and cloud sync
INTEGRATION TESTS
  • Full pipeline: sensor → edge → cloud → dashboard → alert
  • Multi-node failover and reconnection
  • Alert accuracy under concurrent threshold breaches
PERFORMANCE TESTS
  • Continuous operation for 72 hours without memory leak
  • End-to-end latency < 500 ms at 10 msg/sec
  • ML inference time < 50 ms on-device
  • System recovery time < 30 seconds after power loss

debug_guide:
Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, run I2C scanner sketch

Issue: Wi-Fi/LoRa connection instability
Fix:   Add exponential backoff reconnection, check antenna placement

Issue: MQTT / cloud sync failure
Fix:   Verify TLS certificates, broker ACL rules, and topic permissions

Issue: ML model inference incorrect
Fix:   Re-calibrate input normalization, check TFLite model quantization

Issue: Memory leak after extended run
Fix:   Use heap profiler, avoid dynamic allocation in main loop

Issue: Multi-node desync
Fix:   Enable NTP time sync across all nodes, use MQTT retained messages

Recommended Tools:
  • Serial Monitor + remote syslog
  • MQTT Explorer with TLS support
  • Logic Analyzer + oscilloscope
  • Wireshark for network debugging
  • Node-RED + InfluxDB + Grafana stack

common_issues.fix: Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, confirm I2C address with scanner sketch
Add reconnection logic in loop(), increase TX power, check router channel congestion
Verify broker IP, port 1883/8883, credentials, and firewall rules
Check relay coil voltage, transistor base current, and power supply current capacity
Verify MQTT subscriber is active, check Node-RED debug tab for incoming messages

debug_guide:
Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, confirm I2C address

Issue: Wi-Fi connection drops intermittently
Fix:   Add reconnection logic in loop(), increase TX power

Issue: MQTT broker not receiving messages
Fix:   Verify broker IP, port 1883/8883, credentials and firewall rules

Issue: Actuator not responding
Fix:   Check relay coil voltage and transistor base current

Issue: Dashboard shows stale data
Fix:   Verify MQTT subscriber is active, check Node-RED debug tab

Recommended Tools:
  • Serial Monitor (115200 baud)
  • MQTT Explorer client
  • Logic Analyzer
  • Multimeter
  • Node-RED Debug nodes

Fix:   Add exponential backoff reconnection, check antenna placement

Fix:   Verify TLS certificates, broker ACL rules, and topic permissions

Fix:   Re-calibrate input normalization, check TFLite model quantization

debug_guide:
Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, run I2C scanner sketch

Issue: Wi-Fi/LoRa connection instability
Fix:   Add exponential backoff reconnection, check antenna placement

Issue: MQTT / cloud sync failure
Fix:   Verify TLS certificates, broker ACL rules, and topic permissions

Issue: ML model inference incorrect
Fix:   Re-calibrate input normalization, check TFLite model quantization

Issue: Memory leak after extended run
Fix:   Use heap profiler, avoid dynamic allocation in main loop

Issue: Multi-node desync
Fix:   Enable NTP time sync across all nodes, use MQTT retained messages

Recommended Tools:
  • Serial Monitor + remote syslog
  • MQTT Explorer with TLS support
  • Logic Analyzer + oscilloscope
  • Wireshark for network debugging
  • Node-RED + InfluxDB + Grafana stack

Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, confirm I2C address

Issue: Wi-Fi connection drops intermittently
Fix:   Add reconnection logic in loop(), increase TX power

Issue: MQTT broker not receiving messages
Fix:   Verify broker IP, port 1883/8883, credentials and firewall rules

Fix:   Check relay coil voltage and transistor base current

Issue: Dashboard shows stale data
Fix:   Verify MQTT subscriber is active, check Node-RED debug tab

Recommended Tools:
  • Serial Monitor (115200 baud)
  • MQTT Explorer client
  • Logic Analyzer
  • Multimeter
  • Node-RED Debug nodes

Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, run I2C scanner sketch

Fix:   Add exponential backoff reconnection, check antenna placement

Issue: MQTT / cloud sync failure
Fix:   Verify TLS certificates, broker ACL rules, and topic permissions

Issue: ML model inference incorrect
Fix:   Re-calibrate input normalization, check TFLite model quantization

Fix:   Use heap profiler, avoid dynamic allocation in main loop

Fix:   Enable NTP time sync across all nodes, use MQTT retained messages

  • MQTT Explorer with TLS support
  • Logic Analyzer + oscilloscope

debug_guide:
Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, run I2C scanner sketch

Issue: Wi-Fi/LoRa connection instability
Fix:   Add exponential backoff reconnection, check antenna placement

Issue: MQTT / cloud sync failure
Fix:   Verify TLS certificates, broker ACL rules, and topic permissions

Issue: ML model inference incorrect
Fix:   Re-calibrate input normalization, check TFLite model quantization

Issue: Memory leak after extended run
Fix:   Use heap profiler, avoid dynamic allocation in main loop

Issue: Multi-node desync
Fix:   Enable NTP time sync across all nodes, use MQTT retained messages

Recommended Tools:
  • Serial Monitor + remote syslog
  • MQTT Explorer with TLS support
  • Logic Analyzer + oscilloscope
  • Wireshark for network debugging
  • Node-RED + InfluxDB + Grafana stack

debug_guide:
Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, run I2C scanner sketch

Issue: Wi-Fi/LoRa connection instability
Fix:   Add exponential backoff reconnection, check antenna placement

Issue: MQTT / cloud sync failure
Fix:   Verify TLS certificates, broker ACL rules, and topic permissions

Issue: ML model inference incorrect
Fix:   Re-calibrate input normalization, check TFLite model quantization

Issue: Memory leak after extended run
Fix:   Use heap profiler, avoid dynamic allocation in main loop

Issue: Multi-node desync
Fix:   Enable NTP time sync across all nodes, use MQTT retained messages

Recommended Tools:
  • Serial Monitor + remote syslog
  • MQTT Explorer with TLS support
  • Logic Analyzer + oscilloscope
  • Wireshark for network debugging
  • Node-RED + InfluxDB + Grafana stack

Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, confirm I2C address

Issue: Wi-Fi connection drops intermittently
Fix:   Add reconnection logic in loop(), increase TX power

Issue: MQTT broker not receiving messages
Fix:   Verify broker IP, port 1883/8883, credentials and firewall rules

Issue: Actuator not responding
Fix:   Check relay coil voltage and transistor base current

Issue: Dashboard shows stale data
Fix:   Verify MQTT subscriber is active, check Node-RED debug tab

Recommended Tools:
  • Serial Monitor (115200 baud)
  • MQTT Explorer client
  • Logic Analyzer
  • Multimeter
  • Node-RED Debug nodes

Fix:   Verify TLS certificates, broker ACL rules, and topic permissions

code.explanation:
This Python implementation for Autonomous Car Parking Robot (Intermediate level) covers:
1. Hardware initialization and pin configuration
2. Sensor reading with error handling

  • MQTT publish rate: 1 msg/sec sustained

debug_guide:
Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, confirm I2C address

Issue: Wi-Fi connection drops intermittently
Fix:   Add reconnection logic in loop(), increase TX power

Issue: MQTT broker not receiving messages
Fix:   Verify broker IP, port 1883/8883, credentials and firewall rules

Issue: Actuator not responding
Fix:   Check relay coil voltage and transistor base current

Issue: Dashboard shows stale data
Fix:   Verify MQTT subscriber is active, check Node-RED debug tab

Recommended Tools:
  • Serial Monitor (115200 baud)
  • MQTT Explorer client
  • Logic Analyzer
  • Multimeter
  • Node-RED Debug nodes

Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, run I2C scanner sketch

Fix:   Add exponential backoff reconnection, check antenna placement

Issue: MQTT / cloud sync failure
Fix:   Verify TLS certificates, broker ACL rules, and topic permissions

Fix:   Re-calibrate input normalization, check TFLite model quantization

debug_guide:
Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, run I2C scanner sketch

Issue: Wi-Fi/LoRa connection instability
Fix:   Add exponential backoff reconnection, check antenna placement

Issue: MQTT / cloud sync failure
Fix:   Verify TLS certificates, broker ACL rules, and topic permissions

Issue: ML model inference incorrect
Fix:   Re-calibrate input normalization, check TFLite model quantization

Issue: Memory leak after extended run
Fix:   Use heap profiler, avoid dynamic allocation in main loop

Issue: Multi-node desync
Fix:   Enable NTP time sync across all nodes, use MQTT retained messages

Recommended Tools:
  • Serial Monitor + remote syslog
  • MQTT Explorer with TLS support
  • Logic Analyzer + oscilloscope
  • Wireshark for network debugging
  • Node-RED + InfluxDB + Grafana stack
