debug_guide:
Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, confirm I2C address

Issue: Wi-Fi connection drops intermittently
Fix:   Add reconnection logic in loop(), increase TX power

Issue: MQTT broker not receiving messages
Fix:   Verify broker IP, port 1883/8883, credentials and firewall rules

Issue: Actuator not responding
Fix:   Check relay coil voltage and transistor base current

Issue: Dashboard shows stale data
Fix:   Verify MQTT subscriber is active, check Node-RED debug tab

Recommended Tools:
  • Serial Monitor (115200 baud)
  • MQTT Explorer client
  • Logic Analyzer
  • Multimeter
  • Node-RED Debug nodes

debug_guide:
Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, run I2C scanner sketch

Issue: Wi-Fi/LoRa connection instability
Fix:   Add exponential backoff reconnection, check antenna placement

Issue: MQTT / cloud sync failure
Fix:   Verify TLS certificates, broker ACL rules, and topic permissions

Issue: ML model inference incorrect
Fix:   Re-calibrate input normalization, check TFLite model quantization

Issue: Memory leak after extended run
Fix:   Use heap profiler, avoid dynamic allocation in main loop

Issue: Multi-node desync
Fix:   Enable NTP time sync across all nodes, use MQTT retained messages

Recommended Tools:
  • Serial Monitor + remote syslog
  • MQTT Explorer with TLS support
  • Logic Analyzer + oscilloscope
  • Wireshark for network debugging
  • Node-RED + InfluxDB + Grafana stack

code.explanation:
This MicroPython implementation for Cold Chain Asset Monitor (Advanced level) covers:
1. Hardware initialization and pin configuration
2. Sensor reading with error handling
3. Actuator control logic based on threshold values
4. MQTT publish to broker for real-time dashboard
5. Alert triggers when readings exceed safe limits
6. Cloud sync to Firebase/AWS IoT for remote access
7. On-device ML inference for anomaly detection

testing_procedure:
UNIT TESTS
  • Verify all sensor readings within calibrated range
  • Test actuator response time < 100 ms
  • Validate MQTT QoS 2 delivery and cloud sync
INTEGRATION TESTS
  • Full pipeline: sensor → edge → cloud → dashboard → alert
  • Multi-node failover and reconnection
  • Alert accuracy under concurrent threshold breaches
PERFORMANCE TESTS
  • Continuous operation for 72 hours without memory leak
  • End-to-end latency < 500 ms at 10 msg/sec
  • ML inference time < 50 ms on-device
  • System recovery time < 30 seconds after power loss

debug_guide:
Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, run I2C scanner sketch

Issue: Wi-Fi/LoRa connection instability
Fix:   Add exponential backoff reconnection, check antenna placement

Issue: MQTT / cloud sync failure
Fix:   Verify TLS certificates, broker ACL rules, and topic permissions

Issue: ML model inference incorrect
Fix:   Re-calibrate input normalization, check TFLite model quantization

Issue: Memory leak after extended run
Fix:   Use heap profiler, avoid dynamic allocation in main loop

Issue: Multi-node desync
Fix:   Enable NTP time sync across all nodes, use MQTT retained messages

Recommended Tools:
  • Serial Monitor + remote syslog
  • MQTT Explorer with TLS support
  • Logic Analyzer + oscilloscope
  • Wireshark for network debugging
  • Node-RED + InfluxDB + Grafana stack

Add reconnection logic in loop(), increase TX power, check router channel congestion
Verify broker IP, port 1883/8883, credentials, and firewall rules
Check relay coil voltage, transistor base current, and power supply current capacity
Verify MQTT subscriber is active, check Node-RED debug tab for incoming messages

debug_guide:
Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, confirm I2C address

Issue: Wi-Fi connection drops intermittently
Fix:   Add reconnection logic in loop(), increase TX power

Issue: MQTT broker not receiving messages
Fix:   Verify broker IP, port 1883/8883, credentials and firewall rules

Issue: Actuator not responding
Fix:   Check relay coil voltage and transistor base current

Issue: Dashboard shows stale data
Fix:   Verify MQTT subscriber is active, check Node-RED debug tab

Recommended Tools:
  • Serial Monitor (115200 baud)
  • MQTT Explorer client
  • Logic Analyzer
  • Multimeter
  • Node-RED Debug nodes

debug_guide:
Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, confirm I2C address

Issue: Wi-Fi connection drops intermittently
Fix:   Add reconnection logic in loop(), increase TX power

Issue: MQTT broker not receiving messages
Fix:   Verify broker IP, port 1883/8883, credentials and firewall rules

Issue: Actuator not responding
Fix:   Check relay coil voltage and transistor base current

Issue: Dashboard shows stale data
Fix:   Verify MQTT subscriber is active, check Node-RED debug tab

Recommended Tools:
  • Serial Monitor (115200 baud)
  • MQTT Explorer client
  • Logic Analyzer
  • Multimeter
  • Node-RED Debug nodes

debug_guide:
Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, run I2C scanner sketch

Issue: Wi-Fi/LoRa connection instability
Fix:   Add exponential backoff reconnection, check antenna placement

Issue: MQTT / cloud sync failure
Fix:   Verify TLS certificates, broker ACL rules, and topic permissions

Issue: ML model inference incorrect
Fix:   Re-calibrate input normalization, check TFLite model quantization

Issue: Memory leak after extended run
Fix:   Use heap profiler, avoid dynamic allocation in main loop

Issue: Multi-node desync
Fix:   Enable NTP time sync across all nodes, use MQTT retained messages

Recommended Tools:
  • Serial Monitor + remote syslog
  • MQTT Explorer with TLS support
  • Logic Analyzer + oscilloscope
  • Wireshark for network debugging
  • Node-RED + InfluxDB + Grafana stack

code.explanation:
This Python (Raspberry Pi) implementation for Smart Asset Check-In/Out System (Advanced level) covers:
1. Hardware initialization and pin configuration
2. Sensor reading with error handling
3. Actuator control logic based on threshold values
4. MQTT publish to broker for real-time dashboard
5. Alert triggers when readings exceed safe limits
6. Cloud sync to Firebase/AWS IoT for remote access
7. On-device ML inference for anomaly detection

testing_procedure:

  • Multi-node failover and reconnection

PERFORMANCE TESTS
  • Continuous operation for 72 hours without memory leak
  • End-to-end latency < 500 ms at 10 msg/sec
  • ML inference time < 50 ms on-device
  • System recovery time < 30 seconds after power loss

debug_guide:
Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, run I2C scanner sketch

Issue: Wi-Fi/LoRa connection instability
Fix:   Add exponential backoff reconnection, check antenna placement

Issue: MQTT / cloud sync failure
Fix:   Verify TLS certificates, broker ACL rules, and topic permissions

Issue: ML model inference incorrect
Fix:   Re-calibrate input normalization, check TFLite model quantization

Issue: Memory leak after extended run
Fix:   Use heap profiler, avoid dynamic allocation in main loop

Issue: Multi-node desync
Fix:   Enable NTP time sync across all nodes, use MQTT retained messages

Recommended Tools:
  • Serial Monitor + remote syslog
  • MQTT Explorer with TLS support
  • Logic Analyzer + oscilloscope
  • Wireshark for network debugging
  • Node-RED + InfluxDB + Grafana stack

common_issues.fix: Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, confirm I2C address with scanner sketch
Add reconnection logic in loop(), increase TX power, check router channel congestion
Verify broker IP, port 1883/8883, credentials, and firewall rules
Check relay coil voltage, transistor base current, and power supply current capacity
Verify MQTT subscriber is active, check Node-RED debug tab for incoming messages

debug_guide:
Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, run I2C scanner sketch

Issue: Wi-Fi/LoRa connection instability
Fix:   Add exponential backoff reconnection, check antenna placement

Issue: MQTT / cloud sync failure
Fix:   Verify TLS certificates, broker ACL rules, and topic permissions

Issue: ML model inference incorrect
Fix:   Re-calibrate input normalization, check TFLite model quantization

Issue: Memory leak after extended run
Fix:   Use heap profiler, avoid dynamic allocation in main loop

Issue: Multi-node desync
Fix:   Enable NTP time sync across all nodes, use MQTT retained messages

Recommended Tools:
  • Serial Monitor + remote syslog
  • MQTT Explorer with TLS support
  • Logic Analyzer + oscilloscope
  • Wireshark for network debugging
  • Node-RED + InfluxDB + Grafana stack

Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, run I2C scanner sketch

Issue: Wi-Fi/LoRa connection instability
Fix:   Add exponential backoff reconnection, check antenna placement

Issue: MQTT / cloud sync failure
Fix:   Verify TLS certificates, broker ACL rules, and topic permissions

Issue: ML model inference incorrect
Fix:   Re-calibrate input normalization, check TFLite model quantization

Issue: Memory leak after extended run
Fix:   Use heap profiler, avoid dynamic allocation in main loop

Issue: Multi-node desync
Fix:   Enable NTP time sync across all nodes, use MQTT retained messages

Recommended Tools:
  • Serial Monitor + remote syslog
  • MQTT Explorer with TLS support
  • Logic Analyzer + oscilloscope
  • Wireshark for network debugging
  • Node-RED + InfluxDB + Grafana stack

Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, run I2C scanner sketch

Issue: Wi-Fi/LoRa connection instability
Fix:   Add exponential backoff reconnection, check antenna placement

Issue: MQTT / cloud sync failure
Fix:   Verify TLS certificates, broker ACL rules, and topic permissions

Issue: ML model inference incorrect
Fix:   Re-calibrate input normalization, check TFLite model quantization

Issue: Memory leak after extended run
Fix:   Use heap profiler, avoid dynamic allocation in main loop

Issue: Multi-node desync
Fix:   Enable NTP time sync across all nodes, use MQTT retained messages

Recommended Tools:
  • Serial Monitor + remote syslog
  • MQTT Explorer with TLS support
  • Logic Analyzer + oscilloscope
  • Wireshark for network debugging
  • Node-RED + InfluxDB + Grafana stack

code.explanation:
This Python implementation for Artwork & Artifact Location Monitor (Advanced level) covers:
1. Hardware initialization and pin configuration
2. Sensor reading with error handling
3. Actuator control logic based on threshold values
4. MQTT publish to broker for real-time dashboard
5. Alert triggers when readings exceed safe limits
6. Cloud sync to Firebase/AWS IoT for remote access
7. On-device ML inference for anomaly detection

testing_procedure:
UNIT TESTS
  • Verify all sensor readings within calibrated range
  • Test actuator response time < 100 ms
  • Validate MQTT QoS 2 delivery and cloud sync
INTEGRATION TESTS
  • Full pipeline: sensor → edge → cloud → dashboard → alert
  • Multi-node failover and reconnection
  • Alert accuracy under concurrent threshold breaches
PERFORMANCE TESTS
  • Continuous operation for 72 hours without memory leak
  • End-to-end latency < 500 ms at 10 msg/sec
  • ML inference time < 50 ms on-device
  • System recovery time < 30 seconds after power loss

debug_guide:
Issue: Sensor reading shows 0 or NaN
Fix:   Check wiring, verify pull-up/pull-down resistors, run I2C scanner sketch

Issue: Wi-Fi/LoRa connection instability
Fix:   Add exponential backoff reconnection, check antenna placement

Issue: MQTT / cloud sync failure
Fix:   Verify TLS certificates, broker ACL rules, and topic permissions

Issue: ML model inference incorrect
Fix:   Re-calibrate input normalization, check TFLite model quantization

Issue: Memory leak after extended run
Fix:   Use heap profiler, avoid dynamic allocation in main loop

Issue: Multi-node desync
Fix:   Enable NTP time sync across all nodes, use MQTT retained messages

Recommended Tools:
  • Serial Monitor + remote syslog
  • MQTT Explorer with TLS support
  • Logic Analyzer + oscilloscope
  • Wireshark for network debugging
  • Node-RED + InfluxDB + Grafana stack

Add reconnection logic in loop(), increase TX power, check router channel congestion
Verify broker IP, port 1883/8883, credentials, and firewall rules
Check relay coil voltage, transistor base current, and power supply current capacity
Verify MQTT subscriber is active, check Node-RED debug tab for incoming messages
